sq.QUESTION_DESC: \(\text{What is harmonic analysis in context of Fourier series?}\)

sq.ANSWER:
Upto the stepMarks

\(\text{For } m=6 \text{ intervals, } h = \frac{2\pi}{6} = \frac{\pi}{3}\)

(2 Mark)

\(a_0 = \frac{2}{6} \sum_{i=0}^{5} y_i, \quad a_n = \frac{2}{6} \sum_{i=0}^{5} y_i \cos(nx_i)\)

(3 Mark)

\(b_n = \frac{2}{6} \sum_{i=0}^{5} y_i \sin(nx_i), \quad x_i = i\cdot\frac{\pi}{3}\)

(3 Mark)

sq.QUESTION_DESC: \(\text{Why are m=6,12,24 commonly used in harmonic analysis?}\)

sq.ANSWER:
Upto the stepMarks

\(\text{Compute } \cos x_i \text{ at each point: } 1, 0.5, -0.5, -1, -0.5, 0.5\)

(3 Mark)

\(\text{Multiply each } y_i \text{ by corresponding } \cos x_i\)

(2 Mark)

\(\text{Sum products: } \sum y_i \cos x_i\)

(2 Mark)

\(a_1 = \frac{2}{6} \times \text{sum} = \frac{1}{3} \sum y_i \cos x_i\)

(1 Mark)
sq.QUESTION_DESC: \(\text{For data at } x=0,\frac{\pi}{3},\frac{2\pi}{3},\pi,\frac{4\pi}{3},\frac{5\pi}{3} \text{ with y-values, how to compute } a_1?\)

lq.ANSWER:
StepMarks
Form: \(y=\frac{a_0}{2}+a_1\cos x+a_2\cos 2x+b_1\sin x+b_2\sin 2x\)(1)
\(a_0=\frac{2}{6}\sum y=2.9\)(2)
\(a_1=\frac{2}{6}\sum y\cos x=-0.367\), \(a_2=\frac{2}{6}\sum y\cos 2x=-0.1\)(4)
\(b_1=\frac{2}{6}\sum y\sin x=0.175\), \(b_2=\frac{2}{6}\sum y\sin 2x=-0.0593\)(4)
Thus, \(y=1.45-0.367\cos x-0.1\cos 2x+0.175\sin x-0.0593\sin 2x\)(4)
lq.QUESTION_DESC: Given the data: \(x:0,\frac{\pi}{3},\frac{2\pi}{3},\pi,\frac{4\pi}{3},\frac{5\pi}{3}; y:0,1.4,1.9,1.7,1.5,1.2\). Find the Fourier series upto second harmonic.

lq.ANSWER:
StepMarks
Map to \((0,2\pi)\): Let \(t=\frac{2\pi x}{T}\)(2)
Form: \(y=\frac{a_0}{2}+a_1\cos t+a_2\cos 2t+b_1\sin t+b_2\sin 2t\)(1)
Compute sums: \(\sum y=4.5\), \(\sum y\cos t=1.12\), \(\sum y\cos 2t=2.67\)(4)
\(\sum y\sin t=3.014\), \(\sum y\sin 2t=-0.328\)(3)
Coefficients: \(a_0=1.5,a_1=0.373,a_2=0.89,b_1=1.005,b_2=-0.109\)(3)
Thus, \(y=0.75+0.373\cos t+0.89\cos 2t+1.005\sin t-0.109\sin 2t\)(2)
